title: Cover contract through the BIA near White Sands
place_text: sovereign nation near White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico

tellings.quote: we had a a cover contract through the BIA, which is the Bureau of Indian Affairs at a sovereign nation close to White Sands uh missile range in New Mexico.

plain: In 2001, according to the former helicopter pilot Jake Barber, who says he flew missions to recover UFOs, his team worked under a cover contract with the Bureau of Indian Affairs, placed with a sovereign tribal nation close to White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico. Barber tells Michels this as something he took part in; if true, it would mean the work was hidden behind ordinary government paperwork.
